Recorded build & measurement definitions

Peak flow is a 0.5-second rolling clean average, evaluated at 100 ms marks and release. Puffs shorter than 0.5 seconds have no peak. Stability is 100 × (1 − coefficient of variation) within green, floored at zero; it needs at least 0.5 seconds and 0.002 L produced in green. Optimal-zone volume counts actual clean output in green. Smoke burden is smoke ÷ (clean + smoke). These are fictional game measurements, with no lung-health interpretation.

Workshop settings

Progress saves locally. Gameplay pauses when hidden or browsing other screens. Hold Puff / Space, Refill / R, Recharge / C. Only one action at a time. Voltage and hardware lock for the session. Tank and internal battery are device storage; external pack and liquid reserve are permanent Supplies upgrades. All refill at session start. Energy is consumed only when firing, never counted again during recharge. End the session to bank Credits early. Older missing energy readings remain unrecorded. Purchased leftover liquid from older saves is refunded once at 0.4 Credits/mL. Heat Retention slows passive heat loss; Active Cooling works during actual transfers only. Refund upgrades between sessions; old ledger entries are labelled estimated. Throughput rewards clean L/s; ending before using 75% of either resource budget reduces the session commitment multiplier to prevent free-supply restart farming. Wick saturation below 40% limits clean output, and below 10% causes dry hits. Tank-to-wick absorption is a transfer; only firing consumes liquid. A new session primes the wick from its existing supply budget. Old active sessions keep their previous delivery model. Equipment and thermal behavior are fictional game mechanics.
